_note: Original grammar notes for the unit guidebooks. Keyed by level, then unit key (UNIT_DEFS in index.html). Each tip: title, explain, pattern [[form, meaning]], examples [[hanzi, pinyin, english]].

dasar.title: Saying what something is with 是
dasar.explain: 是 links two nouns, like "am / is / are". Put 不 in front of 是 to say "is not".

dasar.title: Yes/no questions with 吗
dasar.explain: Add 吗 to the end of a statement to turn it into a yes/no question. The word order does not change.

waktu.title: Numbers need a measure word
waktu.explain: Between a number (or 这/那) and a noun you need a measure word. 个 is the most common one.

waktu.title: Big to small: dates and times
waktu.explain: Chinese puts time from the largest unit to the smallest: year → month → day → time. Time words come before the verb.
pattern: 年 → 月 → 号 → 点
examples: Jīntiān shì wǔ yuè sān hào.

orang.title: Possession with 的
orang.explain: 的 works like "'s": the owner comes first. With close family or people, 的 is often dropped (我妈妈).

orang.title: Plural people with 们
orang.explain: 们 after a pronoun or a word for people makes it plural. It is not used after numbers.
pattern: 我们 / 你们 / 他们

tubuh.title: Describing with 很 + adjective
tubuh.explain: Adjectives work like verbs: do not use 是 before them. In plain statements 很 usually goes in front, even when it doesn't mean "very".

makan.title: Wanting: 想 and 要
makan.explain: 想 + verb = would like to (soft). 要 + noun/verb = want (more direct; common when ordering).
examples: I want a cup of tea.
What would you like to drink?

rumah.title: Where something is: 在
rumah.explain: 在 + place says where someone or something is. Put location words like 里, 上 after the place.
examples: The book is on the table.
The cat is in the room.

rumah.title: There is: 有
rumah.explain: Place + 有 + thing means "there is ... in/at the place". The negative is always 没有, never 不有.
examples: Zhuōzi shang yǒu yì běn shū.
There's a book on the table.

sekolah.title: Learned ability: 会
sekolah.explain: 会 + verb means "can" for skills you have learned (languages, swimming, cooking).

jalan.title: Going and coming: 去 / 来
jalan.explain: 去 + place = go there (away from the speaker). 来 + place = come here (toward the speaker). Add a time before the verb.
examples: He's going to the hospital tomorrow.

jalan.title: How to do something: 怎么
jalan.explain: 怎么 + verb asks how to do something. 怎么去 is how to ask for directions or transport.
examples: How do I get to the train station?
How do you read this character?
How do you get to school?

belanja.title: Asking amounts: 多少 and 几
belanja.explain: 几 asks about small numbers (usually under 10) and needs a measure word. 多少 is for any number; 多少钱 asks the price.
examples: How many children do you have?

hobi.title: Likes: 喜欢 + verb/noun
hobi.explain: 喜欢 can take a noun or a whole activity. 不喜欢 for dislikes.

alam.title: Too / so: 太 … 了
alam.explain: 太 + adjective + 了 gives a strong exclamation: "so ...!" or "too ...".

alam.title: How is it? 怎么样
alam.explain: 怎么样 at the end asks for an opinion or how something is.
examples: Let's go tomorrow, how about it?

sifat.title: And you? Questions with 呢
sifat.explain: After saying something about yourself, ask the same question back with "you + 呢".
examples: I'll have tea, what about you?

umum.title: Completed actions with 了
umum.explain: 了 after the verb shows the action happened. The negative uses 没 + verb, without 了.
examples: Wǒ mǎi le yì běn shū.

fungsi.title: Also and all: 也 / 都
fungsi.explain: 也 (also) and 都 (all/both) are adverbs: they go after the subject and before the verb — never at the start or the end. Together: 也都.

fungsi.title: Joining nouns with 和
fungsi.explain: 和 joins nouns or pronouns ("and"). It does not join two sentences.
examples: Bàba hé māma dōu zài jiā.
Dad and Mum are both at home.

dasar.title: Suggestions with 吧
dasar.explain: 吧 at the end softens a sentence into a suggestion ("let's", "why don't you") or asks for confirmation.
examples: Why don't you take a rest.

dasar.title: Asking someone to do something: 请 / 让
dasar.explain: 请 + verb is a polite request. 让 + person + verb means "let / make someone do".
examples: Māma ràng wǒ zǎo diǎnr shuìjiào.
Mum makes me go to bed early.

waktu.title: Before / after / when: 以前、以后、的时候
waktu.explain: These time phrases go after the event and before the main clause.
examples: After class I go to the library.
Wǒ xiǎo de shíhou zhù zài Běijīng.
When I was little I lived in Beijing.

waktu.title: Already: 已经 … 了
waktu.explain: 已经 goes before the verb and 了 at the end to say something has already happened or a state has been reached.

orang.title: Comparing with 比
orang.explain: A 比 B + adjective = A is more ... than B. Do not add 很 or 非常; to say "much more", add 多了 after the adjective.
pattern: A 比 B + adjective + 多了
A is not as ... as B
examples: My older brother is taller than me.
Jīntiān bǐ zuótiān lěng duō le.
Today is much colder than yesterday.
I'm not as busy as him.

tubuh.title: A bit: 有点儿 vs 一点儿
tubuh.explain: 有点儿 goes before an adjective, usually for something unwelcome. 一点儿 goes after an adjective (comparison) or before a noun (a little of).
examples: Please speak a bit more slowly.

makan.title: Have you ever? 过
makan.explain: 过 after a verb talks about experience: something has happened at some time in the past. Negative: 没 + verb + 过.
examples: Have you ever been to Shanghai?
Wǒ méi hē guo zhè zhǒng chá.
I've never had this kind of tea.

rumah.title: Ongoing state: verb + 着
rumah.explain: 着 after a verb describes a lasting state (a door is open, a picture is hanging), or how something is done.
examples: Qiáng shang guà zhe yì zhāng huà.
A picture is hanging on the wall.
Tā xiào zhe shuō nǐ hǎo.
He said hello with a smile.

sekolah.title: In progress: 正在 … 呢
sekolah.explain: 正在 (or 在) before the verb says an action is happening right now; 呢 at the end is optional and sounds natural in speech.

jalan.title: Distance with 离
jalan.explain: A 离 B 远/近 says how far A is from B.
pattern: A 离 B + 远 / 近
A is far from / close to B
A 离 B + 有 + distance
examples: Wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào hěn jìn.
My home is close to the school.
Is the airport far from here?
Zhèr lí chēzhàn yǒu liǎng gōnglǐ.
It's two kilometres from here to the station.

jalan.title: From … to …: 从 … 到 …
jalan.explain: 从 and 到 mark a starting point and an end point, in place or time.
examples: 从这儿到那儿要十分钟。
Cóng zhèr dào nàr yào shí fēnzhōng.
It takes ten minutes from here to there.
Wǒ cóng jiǔ diǎn dào wǔ diǎn shàngbān.
I work from nine to five.

belanja.title: Or: 还是 vs 或者
belanja.explain: 还是 is "or" in questions (choose one). 或者 is "or" in statements (either is fine).
examples: Nǐ yào hóng de háishi bái de?
Do you want the red one or the white one?
我们坐公共汽车或者打车吧。
Wǒmen zuò gōnggòng qìchē huòzhě dǎchē ba.
Let's take the bus or a taxi.
Nǐ hē kāfēi háishi hē chá?

hobi.title: How well: verb + 得 + description
hobi.explain: 得 after a verb introduces how well or how something is done. If there is an object, repeat the verb or put the object first.
examples: Nǐ Hànyǔ shuō de zhēn hǎo!

alam.title: About to happen: 要 … 了
alam.explain: 要 (or 快要) + verb + 了 says something is about to happen soon.
examples: The train is about to leave.

alam.title: More and more: 越来越
alam.explain: 越来越 + adjective shows a gradual change.
examples: Tiānqì yuè lái yuè lěng le.
The weather is getting colder and colder.
Tā de Hànyǔ yuè lái yuè hǎo.
Rén yuè lái yuè duō le.
There are more and more people.

sifat.title: Both … and …: 又 … 又 …
sifat.explain: 又 A 又 B links two qualities of the same thing (both positive or both negative).
examples: Zhège píngguǒ yòu dà yòu tián.
This apple is big and sweet.
Jīntiān yòu lěng yòu xià yǔ.

sifat.title: The most: 最
examples: Tā shì wǒmen bān zuì gāo de.
He is the tallest in our class.
Zhè shì zuì hǎo de bànfǎ.

umum.title: Just a little: 看看 / verb + 一下
umum.explain: Repeating a one-syllable verb (看看) or adding 一下 makes the action short and casual, and softens requests.

fungsi.title: Because … so …: 因为 … 所以 …
fungsi.explain: Chinese often uses both halves of the pair. The reason comes first.
examples: Yīnwèi xià yǔ, suǒyǐ wǒ méi qù.
Because it rained, I didn't go.
因为他病了，所以没来上课。
Yīnwèi tā bìng le, suǒyǐ méi lái shàngkè.
He was ill, so he didn't come to class.
因为很累，所以我早睡了。
Yīnwèi hěn lèi, suǒyǐ wǒ zǎo shuì le.
I was tired, so I went to bed early.

fungsi.title: Although … but …: 虽然 … 但是 …
fungsi.explain: 虽然 opens the concession and 但是 (or 可是) gives the contrast. Both halves are normally used.
examples: Suīrán hěn guì, dànshì hěn hǎochī.
虽然他很忙，但是每天都运动。
Suīrán tā hěn máng, dànshì měitiān dōu yùndòng.
Although he's busy, he exercises every day.
Suīrán xià xuě le, kěshì bù lěng.
It's snowing, but it isn't cold.
